messages:
Maria G: quick follow-up from the 03/18 postmortem — KV cache leak that caused OOMs on shard-14. we need concrete owners & timelines for remediation. here's what I propose:

Ajay P: agree. main tracks: profiling + repro, short-term mitigations (softlimits/eviction), long-term GC/allocator changes.

Jamie L: I'll own profiling and repro. plan to run live pprof sampling on canary cluster tonight. command: `go tool pprof http://canary:6060/debug/pprof/heap` — will share heap diff and flamegraphs by EOD tomorrow.

Sylvie K: I'll take softlimit rollout. propose softlimit=70% of RSS + queue-eviction for large prefixes. canary 10% traffic, monitor alloc growth metric `kv.alloc_delta`.

Ajay P: I'll prototype a background slab compaction GC that frees fragmented segments. estimate 2 sprints. will push design doc by Friday: https://redwood.internal/docs/kv-compaction-proposal

Maria G: tentative deadlines: profiling results by 2026-03-24, softlimit canary by 2026-03-25, compaction doc by 2026-03-28. owners confirm?

Jamie L: confirmed for profiling

Sylvie K: confirmed for softlimits/canary

Ajay P: confirmed for compaction doc

ops-bot: Incident runbook updated: 'kv-oom' template now includes "deploy softlimit" step and owner tag

Tomas: can I help with telemetry? I'll add an alert for 'kv.alloc_delta > 30%/10m' and a dashboard.

Maria G: please add an eval case that reproduces the spike; we want regression alerts tied to prompt sets. milestone: add tests to infra repo.

Jamie L: adding unit/regression harness: `tests/kv/oom_regression.sh` will run pprof scenario in CI canary

Sylvie K: one more ask — add a kill-switch to rollback softlimit quickly. Ops already ok.

Ajay P: noted. will include safe rollback and canary rollout steps in design doc.

Maria G: great. I'll own the postmortem follow-up tracking doc and update weekly. sending calendar invites for 30-min syncs (Mon/Wed) :calendar:

Jamie L: :thumbsup:

Sylvie K: :eyes:

Ajay P: adding action items to JIRA (KV-3456, KV-3457, KV-3458). will link here when created.

Maria G: thanks team. ping if blockers. closing thread for now, will reopen with artifacts.
